mapper.insert: INSERT INTO iam_position (position_id, tenant_id, org_id, name, code, level, parent_id, status, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{positionId}, #{tenantId}, #{orgId}, #{name}, #{code}, #{level}, #{parentId}, #{status}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT position_id, tenant_id, org_id, name, code, level, parent_id, status, created_at, updated_at FROM iam_position WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} ORDER BY level, created_at

SELECT position_id, tenant_id, org_id, name, code, level, parent_id, status, created_at, updated_at FROM iam_position WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND (org_id = #{orgId} OR org_id IS NULL) ORDER BY level, created_at
